title: Huntsville City Council Meeting - January 13, 2022
notes: Official Castus captions do not exist for 2022 videos (get-captions returns a signed URL to a nonexistent object), so Whisper is the only transcript source.
Legistar minutes for this meeting were never published: minutes_url is null and status is still Draft.

Fetched and transcribed manually on 2026-09-11, not via hsvcc.py. Note that hsvcc.py transcribe currently fails under torch 2.7.1: whisper.load_model(..., device='mps') cannot move the sparse alignment_heads buffer (no SparseMPS kernel). Workaround used here: load on cpu, densify that buffer, then .to(device).
Contains agenda item 20M, Resolution 22-30, the original Flock Group MOU.
